entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Could I get your full name and order number, please?
Maria Garcia. Order number is VF88602.

Thank you, Maria. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not for me. There was an... issue.
I see. Can you tell me a little more? Understanding the situation helps me find the best solution.
Fine. It was a gift for my husband. He had a medical emergency and ended up in the hospital. He needed surgery. So, he won't be using it.
Oh my, I am so sorry to hear that. I truly hope he has a speedy recovery. Let me just check the return eligibility for you right now.

Okay, thanks for holding. I've reviewed your order, and our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after the delivery date. Since it's only been 19 days, you are well within that window for a full refund. No problem at all.

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label in your email within the next 5 minutes. Just place the VeloBand back in its box, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Whatever. I guess that's one less thing to worry about with his upcoming deployment getting moved up.
I completely understand. I'm glad I could make this part easy for you. Was there anything else I could assist with today, Maria?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your husband and your family all the best.
Thank you for contacting VeloFit. Your call has now ended.
